summary: Frontend-only verification of 3 fixes from iteration 40 plus regressions. All 3 fixes verified PASS: (1) worker route guard redirects /admin/employees|services|settings|blacklist back to /beauty-studio-bor/admin and only 'Rezervacije' nav is rendered; (2) 'Ukloni nalog' now opens confirmation dialog (confirm-delete-account-btn / cancel-delete-account-btn) — cancel keeps account intact, confirm deletes; (3) forced 500 on GET /api/workers/account-statuses now shows toast 'Greška pri učitavanju statusa naloga' instead of silent reset. Regressions verified: bulk account-statuses returns 200 and Marija shows 'Nalog aktivan (worker@salon.com)'; create-account flow (email validation + temp password dialog + copy UI), reset-password flow (new temp password), delete-account confirm path all worked on a TEST account created and cleaned up on worker Milena; admin login shows all 5 nav items; worker login shows read-only CalendarView with worker banner; prev-day disabled on today, next-day enabled and prev becomes enabled after moving forward. Worker credentials (worker@salon.com/Worker123!) re-verified valid after all tests; Marija's account was NOT deleted or reset.

integration_issues.issue: handleLogout redirects worker to /login (super-admin login) instead of /beauty-studio-bor/admin/login — user?.role is already null after await logout(), so the role branch falls through. Low priority.
GET /api/workers/account-statuses fires twice on mount (duplicate toast shown twice in error case). Likely StrictMode/effect double-invoke; harmless in prod but duplicate error toasts are visible.

action_items: Optional: capture role before await logout() so worker logout returns to tenant admin login page
Optional: de-duplicate account-statuses fetch on mount to avoid double toast
critical_code_review_comments: AdminDashboard worker guard is client-side only; ensure backend also rejects worker tokens on admin-only endpoints (blacklist/services/settings) — not re-tested this iteration.
Worker route guard catch-all only exists when isWorker; unknown routes for admins render an empty main area (no 404 fallback).
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted a temporary worker account test_qa_worker@example.com on worker Milena (69d4d6f82990ad8a6366bf7e); cleaned up via confirm-delete dialog. No residual data.
